attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, MariaDB 10.5.29 + Galera 26.4.22 on AlmaLinux 9) holding application data, then added node4 as a 4th member which received full SST of existing data and now accepts writes like the others. Resolved an SELinux AVC denial (mysqld_t self-connectto on unix_stream_socket) blocking mariabackup SST by loading a small custom policy module on all four nodes. Firewalld ports 3306/4444/4567(tcp+udp)/4568 opened on all nodes. Root/app credentials generated on node1 and distributed node-to-node via SSH/scp without ever appearing in command text or output. Completed the mandatory sequential single-node restart protocol on all four nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and cluster health, issued systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified mariadb active + wsrep_cluster_size=4 + Synced + Primary + data intact after each restart, one node at a time, preserving quorum throughout.
